To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a PNA linked to an NLS can be used as an anti-genes agent in intact cells, and that the anti-gene activity is associated to the nuclear localization of the agent and its consequent downregulating effect on the c-myc gene.
a PNA linked to an NLS is able to penetrate the plasma membrane and localize to cell nuclei where it inhibits expression of a translocated c-myc gene.
PNA-myc-NLS is an effective anti-gene agent for the downregulation of the c-myc oncogenes and that this anti-gene agent is effective in live cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of a PNA anti-gene agent as a potential anti-cancer drug.
the development of a new class of anti-gene agents based on PNAs that can be employed in vivo as therapeutic agents.
a new strategy of gene therapy based on PNA molecules that can specifically target and inhibit the transcription of oncogenes in live cells in culture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PNA-myc-NLS, when used at the appropriate concentration and incubation time, can downregulate c-myc expression, arrest the cell cycle, and induce apoptosis.
PNA-myc wt-NLS, by acting as a c-myc antisense, is a powerful tool to inhibit c-myc expression in intact cells in a very efficient manner.
a PNA anti-gene construct linked to an NLS, can be used as an anti-cancer agent in intact cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the anti-gene PNAS, when linked to a NLS, may represent a promising approach to inhibit the growth of c-myc-overexpressing tumors in vivo.
a synthetic PNA linked to an NLS is a potent inhibitor of the expression of the c-myc oncogenes, and it may represent a promising tool for gene therapy.
the PNA-myc anti-genes are able to enter the nuclei of BL cells and down-regulate the expression of c-myc, leading to the arrest of cell proliferation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PNA constructs, when properly designed and targeted, may have therapeutic potential in cancer treatment.
PNA-myc wt-NLS, when used in BL cells, can down-regulate c-myc expression in the cell nuclei.
PNA constructs, when properly designed, can be used as anti-gene agents in live cells.
